custom_button = {
	name = DA_GM_act_ward_wall
	tooltip = DA_GM_card_ward_wall_tt
	potential = {
		has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.abjuration
	}
	trigger = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.ward_wall } } DA_GM_can_convene_ward_wall = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.ward_wall NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_wall } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.ward_wall } } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_gathering_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.ward_wall } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_firing_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_wall } DA_GM_can_release_ward_wall = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.ward_wall } } DA_GM_convene_ward_wall = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_wall } DA_GM_release_ward_wall = yes }
	}
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.ward_wall has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.ward_wall } } }
	frame = { number = 2 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.ward_wall } }
	frame = { number = 5 trigger = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cdy_1 value = 1 } } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { DA_GM_can_convene_ward_wall = yes } }
	frame = { number = 6 trigger = { always = yes } }
}

custom_button = {
	name = DA_GM_act_thousand_hands
	tooltip = DA_GM_card_thousand_hands_tt
	potential = {
		has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.conjuration
	}
	trigger = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.thousand_hands } } DA_GM_can_convene_thousand_hands = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.thousand_hands NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.thousand_hands } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.thousand_hands } } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_gathering_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.thousand_hands } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_firing_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.thousand_hands } DA_GM_can_release_thousand_hands = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.thousand_hands } } DA_GM_convene_thousand_hands = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.thousand_hands } DA_GM_release_thousand_hands = yes }
	}
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.thousand_hands has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.thousand_hands } } }
	frame = { number = 2 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.thousand_hands } }
	frame = { number = 5 trigger = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cdy_4 value = 1 } } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { DA_GM_can_convene_thousand_hands = yes } }
	frame = { number = 6 trigger = { always = yes } }
}

	}

		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grey_tithe NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grey_tithe } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.grey_tithe } } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_gathering_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.grey_tithe } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_firing_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grey_tithe } DA_GM_can_release_grey_tithe = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grey_tithe } } DA_GM_convene_grey_tithe = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grey_tithe } DA_GM_release_grey_tithe = yes }
	}
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grey_tithe has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.grey_tithe } } }
	frame = { number = 2 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grey_tithe } }
	frame = { number = 5 trigger = { check_variable = { which = DA_GM_cdy_20 value = 1 } } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { DA_GM_can_convene_grey_tithe = yes } }
	frame = { number = 6 trigger = { always = yes } }

custom_button = {
	name = DA_GM_act_grand_circle
	tooltip = DA_GM_card_grand_circle_tt
	potential = {
		has_country_flag = DA_GM_page.wheel has_country_flag = DA_GM_sel.grand_circle
	}
	trigger = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grand_circle } } DA_GM_can_convene_grand_circle = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grand_circle NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grand_circle } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.grand_circle } } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_gathering_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.grand_circle } custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GM_is_firing_tt always = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grand_circle } DA_GM_can_release_grand_circle = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grand_circle } } DA_GM_convene_grand_circle = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grand_circle } DA_GM_release_grand_circle = yes }
	}
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_ready.grand_circle has_country_flag = DA_GM_firing.grand_circle } } }
	frame = { number = 2 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_active.grand_circle } }
	frame = { number = 7 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_done.grand_circle } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { DA_GM_can_convene_grand_circle = yes } }
	frame = { number = 6 trigger = { always = yes } }
}

# ROOT = the clicked province, FROM = the country that clicks

custom_button = {
	name = DA_GM_pv_button
	tooltip = DA_GM_pv_button_tt
	potential = {
		FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_holding_target }
	}
	trigger = {
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.ward_of_ages } } DA_GM_target_ok_ward_of_ages = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severance } } DA_GM_target_ok_severance = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.conjured_city } } DA_GM_target_ok_conjured_city = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.host_below } } DA_GM_target_ok_host_below = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.severed_thread } } DA_GM_target_ok_severed_thread = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.crown_of_strings } } DA_GM_target_ok_crown_of_strings = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.skyfall } } DA_GM_target_ok_skyfall = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.rain_of_ruin } } DA_GM_target_ok_rain_of_ruin = yes }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.waking_nightmare } } DA_GM_target_ok_waking_nightmare = yes }

		if = { limit = { FROM = { has_country_flag = DA_GM_aim.red_stone } } DA_GM_target_ok_red_stone = yes }
	}
	effect = {
